Class SubListAdapter

java.lang.Object
myAdapter.VectorAdapter
myAdapter.SubListAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
HCollection, HList
public class SubListAdapter extends VectorAdapter
A view of a portion of a VectorAdapter or another SubListAdapter. The sublist supports all of the optional list operations supported by the backing vector.

This class eliminates the need for explicit range operations. Any operation that expects a list can be used as a range operation by passing a sublist view instead of a whole list.

The semantics of the list returned by this method become undefined if the backing list is structurally modified in any way other than via the returned list. (Structural modifications are those that change the size of the backing list, or otherwise perturb it in such a fashion that iterations in progress may yield incorrect results.)

  • Method Details

    • setSize

      public void setSize(int newSize)
      Sets the size of this sublist. If the new size is greater than the current size, new null items are added to the end of the sublist. If the new size is less than the current size, all components at index newSize and greater are discarded.
      Overrides:
      setSize in class VectorAdapter
      Parameters:
      newSize - the new size of this sublist.
      Throws:
      ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException - if new size is negative.

    • removeElementAt

      public void removeElementAt(int index)
      Deletes the component at the specified index. Each component in this sublist with an index greater or equal to the specified index is shifted downward to have an index one smaller than the value it had previously. The size of this sublist is decreased by 1.

      The index must be a value greater than or equal to 0 and less than the current size of the sublist.

      This method is identical in functionality to the remove method (which is part of the HList interface). Note that the remove method returns the old value that was stored at the specified position.

      Overrides:
      removeElementAt in class VectorAdapter
      Parameters:
      index - the index of the object to remove.
      Throws:
      ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException - if the index was invalid.
      See Also:
      • size()
      • VectorAdapter.remove(int)
      • HList

    • insertElementAt

      public void insertElementAt(Object obj, int index)
      Inserts the specified object as a component in this sublsit at the specified index. Each component in this sublist with an index greater or equal to the specified index is shifted upward to have an index one greater than the value it had previously.

      The index must be a value greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to the current size of the sublist. (If the index is equal to the current size of the sublist, the new element is appended to the sublist.)

      This method is identical in functionality to the add(Object, int) method (which is part of the HList interface). Note that the add method reverses the order of the parameters, to more closely match array usage.

      Overrides:
      insertElementAt in class VectorAdapter
      Parameters:
      obj - the component to insert.
      index - where to insert the new component.
      Throws:
      ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException - if the index was invalid.
      See Also:

      • VectorAdapter.add(int, Object)
